description: This source file implements the command-line interface for connecting to an OpenClaw gateway, including parsing command-line options, resolving gateway endpoints, managing connection state, and outputting connection status reports. It defines data structures for options and output, handles network interactions via an actor, and provides user-facing CLI behavior.

classes.name: ConnectOptions
classes.description: A struct representing CLI options for the connect command, including parsing logic from argument array.

classes.name: ConnectOutput
classes.description: A struct encapsulating the output information for the connection attempt, such as status, URL, scopes, and optional health and snapshot data.

classes.name: SnapshotStore
classes.description: An actor that stores and retrieves a HelloOk snapshot asynchronously during the connection process.

classes.name: GatewayEndpoint
classes.description: A data structure representing the gateway URL, authentication token/password, and mode.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a ConnectOptions instance.

methods.name: runConnect
methods.description: Main asynchronous function executing the connect command logic, handling CLI, network communication, output formatting, and error handling.

methods.name: printConnectOutput
methods.description: Outputs the connection result, either in JSON or human-readable format.

methods.name: resolveGatewayEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves the GatewayEndpoint based on provided options and configuration.
